pages.text: Repair a damaged wagon with iron according to the current repair rules.

pages.title: Fresh Wheels
pages.text: Wheels and two wool colors support maintaining and decorating the wagon already in use.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Iron repairs the wagon under the current repair rules. Wool recoloring consumes no material and does not count for this goal.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Apply Iron Ingots to restore missing durability under the configured repair rules. Crouch-clicking with wool recolors the wagon without consuming it and does not count for this goal.
